recommendation.reason: Agentic clinical GUI benchmark with 216 base tasks across 10 domains, 54.2% best score, deterministic checker and human pilot; no blocking rule.
risks: Single run per task; no run-to-run variability
Safety checker has limited signal; zero critical violations is a floor
Human solvability evidence is a small single-operator pilot
